protocol.name: NayaPOWER Persistent Intelligence Protocol
protocol.claim: Human-owned persistent intelligence protocol intended to preserve governed identity, authorized memory, verified learning, and accountable behavior across models and interfaces.
protocol.canonical_principle: Solve by identity. Choose the most intelligent admissible action. Prove the result. Learn from verified outcomes. Compound responsible value for the person and the hive.

layers.name: NayaPOWER protocol
layers.invariant: Design goal: protocol layer does not run model inference; mechanical enforcement remains unproven until every relevant token-spending path is tested.

layers.name: Authorized AI models
layers.invariant: Integration requires explicit authentication, authorization, scope, revocation, and cold-start tests.

identity_behavior.rule: Identity is an operating principle, not a substitute for evidence or authority.
behaviors: understand mission and current evidence before acting
apply governing law and hard constraints first
use the existing approved Decision Value Calculus
prove learning transfers to a cold successor
authority_invariants: authentication identifies actor but does not grant authority
private memory is not collective by default
identity_behavior.learning_status_rule: Stored or retrieved information is not learned until independent evidence shows behavior and outcome changed and later reuse occurs.

intelligence_hierarchy.type: proposed ordinal behavioral rubric; not a validated universal intelligence test
scoring_rules: score a defined behavior with evidence
do not score intrinsic human worth
do not let averages offset hard safety or authority failures
+9 requires evidence-backed results and responsible compounding value

decision_value.source_of_truth: existing approved Decision Value Calculus; do not create a second calculator
constraints: hard law, safety, privacy, consent, and authority gates cannot be offset by benefit
material unresolved unknowns require UNKNOWN or BLOCKED where they prevent safe action

required: canonical identity, digest, lineage, and receipt
falsifiable claim with applicability and limitations
held-out task showing behavior and outcome change
later reuse by a cold successor
learning_admission.rule: Stored is not learned; retrieved is not applied; linked is not proof.

privacy.sharing: only explicitly authorized distilled intelligence may cross scope boundaries

economics.status: proposal; not proof of delivered terms, profitability, or sustainable margins
economics.inference_cost_status: target design invariant; zero cost and mechanical enforcement are not verified; audit all background-agent and orchestration paths

differentiation.model_providers: models provide capabilities; NayaPOWER aims to preserve user-governed continuity across them
differentiation.routers: routing alone does not establish persistent identity or verified behavior change
differentiation.frameworks: orchestration alone does not establish canonical memory and learning proof
differentiation.apps: interfaces can be doors into a persistent layer if authorization and portability are implemented
differentiation.memory_addons: retrieval alone does not prove that behavior changed

honest_gaps.description: External authorized model connection and scoped contribution must be demonstrated.
Independent verifiers must be able to validate evidence without relying solely on insider assertions.
Token spending and inference responsibility must be attributable, budgeted, and mechanically tested.
Cold successor must locate identity, mission, authority, canonical state, and next action.
Real capture must produce the same canonical learned object, change held-out behavior/outcome, and transfer to a cold successor.
Scope isolation, revocation, and retention/deletion semantics require end-to-end proof.
Cost model must establish sustainable storage, coordination, support, security, compliance, and retention economics.
Measure correct-action latency, comprehension, harmful errors, duplicate work, handoff success, and user outcomes.

status_vocabulary.IMPLEMENTED: code/config exists at a pinned revision
status_vocabulary.VERIFIED: independent evidence supports the stated claim and scope
status_vocabulary.PRODUCTION_PROVEN: exact deployed behavior passed required live proof
status_vocabulary.BLOCKED: required dependency, authority, or verifier prevents a valid verdict
status_vocabulary.LEARNED: independent evidence shows behavior/outcome changed and later transfer occurred
